title: Logo Sting - Game Title Reveal
summary: A 5-6 second logo sting for trailers, devlogs and the boot screen: a motif from the game world builds into the title reveal and ends on a long, stable hold. Works with a supplied logo image as reference (reproduced exactly, never redrawn) or leaves a clean empty title area to composite the logo later.
prompt:
A 5 to 6 second logo sting that reveals the title of an indie game.

Game mood: {argument name="game_mood" default="a melancholic sci-fi exploration game about the last lighthouse keeper on a drifting moon"}.
Logo mode: {argument name="logo_mode" default="if a logo image is attached as reference, reproduce it exactly and never redraw, retype or distort its letters; otherwise leave a clean empty title area in the centre for the logo to be composited later"}.
Visual motif that forms the reveal: {argument name="motif" default="motes of dust caught in a rotating lighthouse beam that sweep across darkness"}.

# Timeline
- 0-1.5s: darkness with the motif slowly appearing, a low hum or ambient tone.
- 1.5-3.5s: the motif accelerates and converges on the centre of the frame, light gathering into the title area; one decisive impact or light flare at about 3.2s.
- 3.5-6s: the title area (logo or clean empty space) is fully revealed and HOLDS perfectly still for at least 2 seconds, with only subtle ambient motion around it (drifting particles, a slow light sweep), so the clip can be cut anywhere in the hold.

# Look
- Style: {argument name="style" default="cinematic, soft volumetric light, fine particles, gentle film grain"}.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="near-black blue background, pale gold light, a hint of cyan in the shadows"}.
- Camera: locked off or a very slow push-in; the title area stays centred and never moves during the hold.
- Sound: {argument name="sound" default="a deep swell into a single resonant chime on the reveal"}.

# Avoid
Generated lettering or fake logos when no reference is given, warped or melting letters, extra slogans, the camera drifting off the title, shaking during the hold, studio logos, watermarks.
